result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk, pedestrian signals, and a dedicated bike lane within a residential context. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic for a significant distance across multiple lanes without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the asphalt within the crosswalk area could pose a tripping hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, within the marked crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Refresh
interventions.description: Repaint the zebra markings with high-visibility thermoplastic to ensure they are clearly seen by approaching drivers.

result.summary: The intersection is controlled by a traffic signal but lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. Residential land use suggests pedestrian activity, yet the environment prioritizes vehicle flow with wide, unmarked pavement and poor sightlines due to overgrown vegetation at the corner.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted markings exist to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to the crossing location at this signalized intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the intersection

hazards.name: Missing Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk ends in a vertical curb with no ramp, creating a significant barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk in the center foreground

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Large, overgrown bushes at the corner property line block visibility between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner lot on the right side of the image

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install two directional curb ramps at each corner to provide accessible transitions to the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-specific signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

result.summary: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but completely lacks pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. While sidewalks are present, the wide, unmarked roadway and lack of designated crossing points create a hostile environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross the intersection, leaving them exposed to traffic without a designated path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks dedicated signals for pedestrians, making it difficult to know when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: On the traffic light pole on the right

hazards.name: Unmarked Travel Lanes
hazards.description: The absence of lane markings can lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning and higher speeds on the wide asphalt surface.
hazards.location_in_image: Road surface throughout the image

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and alert drivers to their presence.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals and improve safety at the signalized intersection.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points to ensure the intersection is accessible for people with disabilities.
